name: Kira Voss
biography: Former frontier surveyor who hears patterns in Mirexis static.

name: Mara Venn
biography: A mining supervisor who held the west tunnel during first contact.

name: Ilya Reed
biography: The colony clinician who learned to treat bodies that no longer follow textbooks.

name: Sol Cairn
biography: A maintenance engineer who can cross a broken gantry faster than most people can climb it.

name: Nadi Vale
biography: A xenobiologist whose quarantine symbiote now answers threats before she sees them.

name: Veya Orn
biography: A former Directorate range officer who crossed the line carrying the colony's stolen fire-control map.
origin_description: Stolen range telemetry makes Veya unusually accurate when the squad must cross open ground.

name: Sedge
biography: A courier from an unregistered Mireborn family whose body learned the marsh before the colony learned its name.
origin_description: A living route-map makes Sedge faster through danger, but the colony must decide whether an old adaptation is inheritance or consent.
